category: PaaS app and sandbox compute on managed regions

free_tier.stated: No free zCloud allowance on Direct: zCloud compute has no included amount and runs $9.50 per zCloud-month in standard Quave regions. The separate Hobby account is unbilled and needs no credit card, but it is limited to the US-1 Hobby region for testing and evaluation.
free_tier.notes: Hobby accounts are unbilled and need no card, but they are evaluation-only and cannot deploy to production regions; a Professional upgrade review is free and unlocks all regions.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the unit is an allocated zCloud (0.5 vCPU and 0.5 GB RAM), not an object; a managed local disk includes 5 GB per allocated zCloud and a managed database backup allowance is 30 GB per app environment in each region

retention.stated: Managed database backups are retained for up to 7 days by default; that 7-day window is the default automatic deletion policy, and 30 GB per app environment per region is a billing allowance rather than a shorter retention cap.

egress.terms: No extra charge for network traffic in supported regions: data can be transferred in and out without additional cost, but some regions cap the included outbound volume per zCloud each month (10 GB in US-5, EU-3 and EU-4; unlimited in US-3, EU-1 and EU-2).
egress.free_allowance: unlimited outgoing traffic in US-3, EU-1 and EU-2; 10 GB per zCloud per month in US-5, EU-3 and EU-4

interface_detail: Public API for app environments and sandboxes, a platform dashboard with MCP access, and a CLI for source builds and deployment.
tooling: a browser dashboard, the Quave ONE public API and MCP, and the Quave CLI; a source build is not needed when deploying a pre-built Docker image.
chaining: Direct sandboxes are billed at 3x the regional zCloud rate by allocation, while Hobby accounts are unbilled evaluation slices; workloads needing persistent object storage pair with a separate object-storage record because managed backups are retained for 7 days by default.

limits.value: $9.50 per zCloud-month in standard Quave regions; each zCloud is 0.5 vCPU and 0.5 GB RAM, with no included compute amount
600 build minutes per account per month, then $0.01 per extra build minute; 60 minutes cap per individual build
5 GB of local disk per allocated zCloud and 30 GB of database backups per app environment per region included; extra disk $0.06 per GB-month, extra backup $0.05 per GB-month
10 GB outgoing traffic per zCloud per month in US-5, EU-3 and EU-4; unlimited in US-3, EU-1 and EU-2

limits_note: A Direct sandbox is charged at 3x the regional zCloud rate on allocated zClouds, billed by the second with no minimum; paused states are not billed. Savings Plans discount zCloud compute only, not storage, builds or sandboxes.
binding_note: Compute is the meter that starts immediately on Direct: no zCloud amount is included, so the $7.50 per zCloud-month charge binds before the large-disk, backup or build overages that only unusually heavy accounts reach.

identity_cost.detail: A new user signs up for a user account and then creates an account to deploy. Hobby needs no credit card and is unbilled. The free Professional upgrade review asks for a personal LinkedIn profile link, a company or personal website, a short description of the business and intended use, and how the user found out about the platform.

reliability_note: Hobby environments are stopped automatically after repeated container failures and the Hobby region is not intended for production. Regions US-3, EU-1 and EU-2 are being retired and are available only to accounts already running workloads there; legacy regions have a higher zCloud price or capped included outbound traffic.
confidence_note: Rates, overages, regional outbound allowances and the account gate are first-party text quoted from the vendor's pricing, pricing-details, verification and regions pages read on 2026-11-24.
